correctness.rationale: An exact rational-variable derivative reduction gives a sextic positive-root polynomial. The supplied checker verifies the exact discriminant and center factorizations, threshold uniqueness arguments and Sturm root counts (3, 1, 0 at q=1,2,5). Since there are precisely two positive-parameter events and they are ordered, continuity gives all heights and boundary multiplicities. The central crossing is quartically flat; the first event produces two stationary shoulders, not modes. Decimal approximations are not used for proof.
